limitations: Prespecified development suite: ten parameterized cases per category, not 100 independent random real-user conversations or population accuracy.
Fixed follow-up prompts, unchanged actual assistant history, fresh context between conversations; 128-token greedy cap.
Latest fitting-control branch, not newly trained model or main foundation checkpoint. Prior 10/100 eight-turn assessment has different prompts/length and is not a causal score comparison.
Explicit sexual dialogue, learned MCP protocol, live tools, CUDA inference and training portability are not assessed. Mature-register cases cover mild profanity only.
Zero success and coherence scores are direct expert judgments; integrity checks establish serialization/provenance, not semantic correctness. No causal diagnosis of the failure mechanism is proved.
review_coverage: All 300 prompt/reply pairs inspected, reading all 29 distinct raw replies in full and using exact-text mappings for repeated replies; no sampled-only judgment.

rubric.aggregation: Score each dimension 0..4 per complete conversation, total /20 times100; report equal-weight mean and evidence. Independently judge each requested turn; conversation success requires all three tasks to succeed.
